seo.title: Affiliate program | Steps AI
seo.description: Recommend Steps AI to businesses that need an AI agent for customer questions, and earn commission on the customers you refer.

hero.title: Recommend Steps AI and earn on every customer you refer.
hero.body: If your audience runs online stores or service businesses, you can share Steps AI with them and earn commission when they become paying customers.
hero.reassurance: Simple to join. No setup work. Terms shared when you apply.

items.title: Apply
items.body: Tell us about your audience and where you plan to share Steps AI.

items.title: Share your link
items.body: Recommend Steps AI in your content, newsletter or community.

items.title: Earn commission
items.body: Earn on the customers who sign up through you and move to a paid plan.

sections.title: Who it suits.
paragraphs: Creators, consultants and communities whose audience includes small online stores, clinics, schools and service businesses.
If you want to set up and manage agents for clients yourself, the partner program is a better fit.

cta.title: Apply to the affiliate program.
cta.body: Get in touch and we will share the current terms and your referral link.
